scope: Corollary 3.5 (Uniform smallness of the tails) of the manuscript “Logarithmic Relative Fluctuations in the Weakly Disordered Planar Ising Model” (preprints/Logarithmic-Relative-Fluctuations-in-the-Weakly-Disordered-Planar-Ising-Model-October-5-2026/critical-relative-second-moment-weak-random-bond-ising.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ec0e1bb240b41be6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For sufficiently large L and then sufficiently small δ, the transformed nonprincipal background satisfies ∥h′ A,c∥∞ ≤ δe−w|A| for every disorder realization. More precisely, with the same output weight w, sup (A,c) ew|A| ∥h′ A,c∥∞ ≤ CLδ2 + CLe−cL δ. (3.22)
